statement: A pinned independent secondary XUSB reference documents Xbox 360 wired USB 045e:028e report type 0x00, 20-byte input with header 00 14: digital buttons and D-pad bits at bytes 2-3, LT/RT at 4-5, four signed 16-bit little-endian stick axes at bytes 6-13, and tail bytes 14-19 typically reserved.

applicability.revision: pinned community Free60 ab1fe19, protoR2 4c0d062, x360w a8ac630; Linux 4056b3c; SDL 535d80b and 829a65d; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: protoR2 179-202, 528-536, traced to USB Host Shield XBOXUSB parser. Secondary reference only (no retail physical capture or manufacturer XUSB body specification in corpus).
